en: Account removal stays effective after restart. Migrated source launches use the same account configuration instead of loading an older copy.
Tasks can switch from a removed account to an available account while preserving their workspace and conversation history. The account selector now matches its actual selection.
Account email addresses are visible by default, with a button to hide them. Deactivated Codex workspaces no longer display old allowance percentages.
Windows source installations use a native launcher to prevent recurring Electron welcome screens caused by missing shortcut arguments.
Update indicators and download actions appear only for a newer version. Older GitHub releases no longer appear as new updates.
zh: 移除账号后重启仍保持移除状态。已迁移的源码入口统一读取同一份账号配置，不再加载旧配置恢复账号。
任务可以从已移除的账号切换到其他可用账号，保留工作目录和对话记录；账号下拉框显示与实际选择保持一致。
账号邮箱默认完整显示，可点击按钮隐藏；Codex 工作区被官方停用时，不再显示旧额度百分比。
Windows 源码版增加独立启动器，修复桌面快捷方式参数丢失后反复打开 Electron 欢迎页的问题。
仅在确有更新版本时显示蓝点和下载操作，不再把较旧的 GitHub 发布版标成新版本。
